scope: Read-only static map. Legacy and current sources are compared but are not merged. No source, database, archive, or external service was changed.
rules: Static evidence is not runtime proof.
CURRENT is not automatically authoritative merely because it is newer.
LEGACY is not automatically reusable merely because it exists.
No REUSE/HARDEN/CONSOLIDATE/RETIRE decision is authorized until owner and runtime trace are completed.
nextGate: For P0 decisions: Evidence, Governance, Product, Supplier, Inventory, Orders, Logistics, Export, Compliance, Knowledge, Brain. Assign an owner and execute isolated acceptance traces only for the candidate selected as potential system of record.
